pairs: Et ostendit mihi fluvium aquæ vitæ,
And he showed me the river of the water of life,
procedentem de sede Dei et Agni.
proceeding from the throne of God and of the Lamb.
In the midst of its main street,
and on both sides of the river,
afferens fructus duodecim per menses singulos,
offering one fruit for each month,
et folia ligni ad sanitatem gentium.
and the leaves of the tree are for the health of the nations.
Et omne maledictum non erit amplius:
And every curse shall be no more.
sed sedes Dei et Agni in illa erunt,
But the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it,
and his servants shall serve him.
And they shall see his face.
et nomen ejus in frontibus eorum.
And his name shall be on their foreheads.
And night shall be no more.
And they will not need the light of a lamp,
nor the light of the sun,
because the Lord God will illuminate them.
And they shall reign forever and ever.
Hæc verba fidelissima sunt, et vera.
“These words are entirely faithful and true.”
Et Dominus Deus spirituum prophetarum misit angelum suum ostendere servis suis quæ oportet fieri cito.
And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his Angel to reveal to his servant what must occur soon:
qui custodit verba prophetiæ libri hujus.
Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
heard and saw these things. And,
after I had heard and seen,
cecidi ut adorarem ante pedes angeli,
so as to adore before the feet of the Angel,
who was revealing these things to me.
For I am your fellow servant,
and I am among your brothers the prophets,
et eorum qui servant verba prophetiæ libri hujus:
and among those who keep the words of the prophecy of this book.
Ne signaveris verba prophetiæ libri hujus:
“Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book.
And my repayment is with me,
to render to each one according to his works.
I am the Alpha and the Omega,
Beati, qui lavant stolas suas in sanguine Agni:
Blessed are those who wash their robes in the blood of the Lamb.
ut sit potestas eorum in ligno vitæ,
So may they have a right to the tree of life;
et per portas intrent in civitatem.
so may they enter through the gates into the City.
et omnis qui amat et facit mendacium.
and all who love and do what is false.
Ego Jesus misi angelum meum testificari vobis hæc in ecclesiis. Ego sum radix, et genus David, stella splendida et matutina.
“I, Jesus, have sent my Angel, to testify to these things for you among the Churches. I am the Root and the Origin of David, the bright morning Star.”
let him accept the water of life,
Contestor enim omni audienti verba prophetiæ libri hujus:
For I call as witnesses all listeners of the words of the prophecy of this book.
If anyone will have added to these,
apponet Deus super illum plagas scriptas in libro isto.
God will add upon him the afflictions written in this book.
Et si quis diminuerit de verbis libri prophetiæ hujus,
And if anyone will have taken away from the words of the book of this prophecy,
auferet Deus partem ejus de libro vitæ,
God will take away his portion from the Book of Life,
et de his quæ scripta sunt in libro isto:
and from these things which have been written in this book.
He who offers testimony to these things, says: “Even now,
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum omnibus vobis.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
